meta_description: Marks Gardens Liverpool offers expert garden design, maintenance and landscaping across Merseyside. Reliable local gardener with 15+ years' experience. Call today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces. Marks Gardens handles everything from design through to ongoing maintenance across Liverpool.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden overhaul, regular maintenance, or specialist landscaping, we've got you covered.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design tailored to your space and budget. We handle hard landscaping, new planting schemes, and water features to create your perfect outdoor room.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Fortnightly or monthly upkeep keeps your garden looking cared for year-round. Grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal planting all included.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Care
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, and removal. We understand local regulations and tree preservation orders, ensuring safe, compliant work every time.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Installation
services.desc: Durable natural stone, block paving, or decking. Our pathways and patios are built to last and designed to make your garden feel inviting and accessible.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown jungle? No problem. We'll clear waste, remove old structures, and leave your garden ready for whatever comes next—all rubbish responsibly disposed of.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Spring bulbs, summer bedding, autumn plantings—we know what thrives in Liverpool's climate. Colour your garden from spring through to the first frost.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated seeing gardens neglected. Simple as that.
about_para_1: Marks Gardens has been helping Liverpool homeowners create beautiful outdoor spaces since 2009. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've kept the same ethos: listen carefully to what you want, quote honestly, and deliver without fuss.
about_para_2: We're not here to oversell you services you don't need. Our customers come back because we turn up on time, do the job right, and leave your garden looking better than when we arrived. In Liverpool, word of mouth still matters—and most of our work now comes from repeat clients and personal recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Marks Gardens

reviews.text: Couldn't fault Mark and the team. Garden was a complete mess when they arrived—overgrown, untidy, just depressing to look at. Six weeks later it's transformed. They've added new borders, a small patio area, and even installed some low-level lighting. Fair price and finished bang on schedule. Will be booking them again in spring.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We've had Mark come every other week for three years now. He knows our garden better than we do at this point! Always reliable, always friendly, keeps everything tidy and the borders looking vibrant. Wouldn't trust anyone else with it.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency clearance before putting the house on the market. Mark came out same day, quoted immediately, and had the whole garden done in a week. The transformation was incredible. Really professional outfit, and honestly cheaper than I expected for the quality of work.
reviews.author: Robert K.
